
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/pie-o/p/20535566" title="发布于 2026-06-15 11:06">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">嵌入式应用开发笔记之web端设备控制台</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>目前正在学习嵌入式应用开发，非科班，非系统学习，半路出家型选手，但是有一定Linux基础，手头正好有一个嵌入式开发设备，硬件资源如下：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>主要参数</th>
<th>配置</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>处理器</td>
<td>单核792MHz Cortex® A7处理器</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>内存</td>
<td>DDR3 512MB</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>存储</td>
<td>eMMC 4GB/8GB</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>RS232</td>
<td>1路调试串口</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>RS485</td>
<td>4路</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CAN-bus</td>
<td>3路</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>以太网</td>
<td>2路</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>软件资源如下：</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<ul>
<li>Ubuntu20.04系统</li>
<li>RT-Linux内核</li>
<li>各种驱动程序</li>
</ul>
<p>我想要把手头这个嵌入式设备的硬件资源都用起来，所以做了一个web端设备控制台应用来练手，其中需要的技术栈有：</p>
<ul>
<li>lighttpd</li>
<li>fcgi</li>
<li>sqlite3</li>
</ul>
<p>接下来就是开发过程了，有几个阶段：</p>
<ul>
<li>开发环境搭建</li>
<li>web服务器及网页设计</li>
<li>cgi后端代码编写（di/do、led、adc、485、CAN、sqlite3)</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="开发环境搭建">开发环境搭建</h3>
<p>采用<code>vscode</code> + <code>docker</code>的方案，其中<code>docker</code>容器提供实际编译环境(<code>arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc</code>等)，<code>vscode</code>用于连接<code>docker</code>容器进行代码编写工作。</p>
<p><code>docker</code>容器部署在宿主机，安装了必要的软件开发包和编译器，并且添加了异质架构，支持<code>arm64</code>，<code>armhf</code>交叉编译</p>
<p>嵌入式设备提供<code>RS232</code>的调试串口，通过这个串口登录到系统中，然后可以进行一些准备工作，比如修改网路设置，因为我需要使用ssh进行宿主机和设备端的连接，并且web服务器也需要解决网络问题。</p>
<p>宿主机可以联网，设备端暂时无法联网，所以需要额外的软件就需要先在宿主机编译源码，然后再<code>scp</code>到设备端，比如<code>lighttpd</code>和<code>sqlite3</code>，设备端本身是没有的</p>
<blockquote>
<p>🧾sqlite3的安装</p>
</blockquote>
<ol>
<li>下载[源码](<a href="https://www.sqlite.org/download.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">SQLite Download Page</a>)到宿主机(docker)，选择<code>sqlite-autoconf-3530200.tar.gz</code>这样的包</li>
<li>用<code>tar</code>进行解压缩，并进入到解压后的目录中</li>
<li>配置编译环境和输出目录，采用静态编译方式</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-bash">./configure \
  --host=arm-linux-gnueabihf \
  --prefix=/tmp/em500/embed_pack/sqlite \
  --disable-readline \
  --disable-shared \
  --enable-static
</code></pre>
<ol start="4">
<li><code>scp</code>可执行文件<code>sqlite3</code>到设备端</li>
<li>其余的输出文件<code>include</code>和<code>lib</code>在cgi代码中会用到</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="web服务器及网页设计">web服务器及网页设计</h3>
<p>首先是对<code>lighttpd.conf</code>文件的配置，这个文件决定了嵌入式设备于浏览器交互过程中调用的<code>fcgi</code>代码，如下所示：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">fastcgi.server = (
    # 把 /api/* 的请求交给 FastCGI 处理
    "/cgi-bin/app.fcgi" =&gt; (
        "app-handler" =&gt; (
            "socket"      =&gt; "/tmp/app.fcgi.socket",
            "check-local" =&gt; "disable",
            # 核心：告诉 lighttpd 用哪个二进制来启动 FCGI 线程池
            "bin-path"    =&gt; "/var/www/cgi-bin/app.fcgi",
            "max-procs"   =&gt; 2,           # 常驻进程数，嵌入式设 1~3 即可
            "idle-timeout"=&gt; 30,
        )
    ),
    "/cgi-bin/history.fcgi" =&gt; (
        "history-handler" =&gt; (
            "socket"      =&gt; "/tmp/history.fcgi.socket",
            "check-local" =&gt; "disable",
            "bin-path"    =&gt; "/var/www/cgi-bin/history.fcgi",
            "max-procs"   =&gt; 1,
            "idle-timeout"=&gt; 30,
        )
    ),
)
</code></pre>
<p>使用到两个<code>fcgi</code>文件：<code>app.fcgi</code>和<code>history.fcgi</code>，这两个<code>fcgi</code>代码在后面介绍</p>
<p>网页的界面设计，借助ai直接生成，很简约，就只有一个页面，页面上的交互控件对应了嵌入式设备本身自带的硬件资源的可控/可读/可写部分，图片如下所示：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1358160/202606/1358160-20260615110359912-1946277059.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在调试cgi功能的时候，有几种调试方式：</p>
<ol>
<li>wireshark抓包：查看数据包的详细信息、包括请求头、请求参数等</li>
<li>浏览器控制台：查看报错信息</li>
<li>cgi代码回发调试信息：浏览器弹窗、控制台打印信息</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="cgi后端代码编写">cgi后端代码编写</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>📢在静态编译时，所有依赖库都需要<mark>显式指定</mark>，包括系统库</p>
</blockquote>
<p>我写了两个<code>fcgi</code>代码，分别是<code>app.fcgi</code>和<code>history.fcgi</code>。</p>
<p>编译<code>history.fcgi</code>的命令如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc \
  -static \
  -o history.fcgi \
  history.cpp \
  -I$TARGET_DIR/usr/local/include \
-I$TARGET_DIR/sqlite/include \
$TARGET_DIR/usr/local/lib/libfcgi.a \
$TARGET_DIR/sqlite/lib/libsqlite3.a \
-lm \
-ldl \
-lpthread
</code></pre>
<p>其中<code>app.fcgi</code>的功能是多路Led指示灯控制、多路数字输出(DO)控制、多路数字输入状态(DI)控制、以及多路ADC模拟量采集</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1358160/202606/1358160-20260615110426044-2060584090.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>对于cgi的交互过程，代码讲解如下：</p>
<p>在web端的js请求：</p>
<p>轮询请求：</p>
<pre><code class="language-js">const response = await fetch('/cgi-bin/app.fcgi');
const data = await response.json();
</code></pre>
<p>发送控制命令：</p>
<pre><code class="language-js">const response = await fetch('/cgi-bin/app.fcgi', {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; method: 'POST',
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; body: JSON.stringify({ type: type, channel: channel,value: value })
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; });
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; const result = await response.json();
</code></pre>
<p>获取历史数据：</p>
<pre><code class="language-js">const url = `/cgi-bin/history.cgi?dataType=${encodeURIComponent(dataType)}&amp;timeRange=${encodeURIComponent(timeRange)}`;
const response = await fetch(url, { method: 'GET' });
</code></pre>
<p>在设备服务器端：</p>
<p>首先是获取请求信息：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">/* 获取请求方法 */
char *method = getenv("REQUEST_METHOD"); 
/* 获取请求资源url */
char *uri = getenv("REQUEST_URI");
</code></pre>
<p>分别处理不同请求：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">// 处理控制请求（POST）

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (strcmp(method, "POST") == 0 &amp;&amp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; strstr(uri, "/cgi-bin/app.fcgi"))
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {
	&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 读取 POST 数据
	&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; FCGI_fread(post_data + bytes_read,1,
	&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; content_length - bytes_read,
	        FCGI_stdin);
	        
	        // 解析JSON
	        /* 解析type */
	        json_get_string(post_data, "\"type\"", type, sizeof(type));
	        /* 解析channel */
	&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; channel = json_get_int(post_data, "\"channel\"");
	&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; /* 解析value */
	&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; value = json_get_int(post_data, "\"value\"");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 
// 处理状态请求（GET）
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; else if (strcmp(method, "GET") == 0 &amp;&amp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;strstr(uri, "/cgi-bin/app.fcgi"))
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ...
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>📞调用硬件资源前，需要确保硬件环境准备完成，包括初始化、配置以及权限</p>
</blockquote>
<p>在调试过程中发现，DO/DI这些资源多涉及到<code>gpio</code>的配置操作，需要做<code>export</code>，然后才能读写</p>
<p>其次是<code>history.fcgi</code>的功能，读取历史记录，数据库是<code>sqlite3</code>，表结构如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE TABLE history(
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
time TEXT, 
volt TEXT,
curr TEXT,
soc TEXT,
loader TEXT);
</code></pre>
<p>读取的历史记录效果如下：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1358160/202606/1358160-20260615110437988-597733668.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1358160/202606/1358160-20260615110443848-1721888813.png" class="lazyload"></p>
